tests.name: test_scaled_member_preserves_nuisances_and_default_bytes
tests.claim: Statistical errors scale about a nuisance-injected center with fixed draws while defaults and nuisance sidecars stay unchanged.
tests.actual: Runs mocked generators at default, explicit k1, k3, and statistically noise-free center; compares four data files, two truth files, one correlated-systematic sidecar and invalid scale.
tests.how: Monkeypatches expensive truth/operators but executes generate_member write and RNG code for both small suites.
tests.bar: exact SHA equality, rtol=1e-11 and atol=1e-11 on scaled arrays; zero scale raises ValueError
tests.catches: Scaling errors without the same noise draw, scaling nuisance shifts, changing default bytes, or altering systematic sidecars.

measurements.claim: A draw function that ignores scaled sigma is rejected
measurements.command: temporary pytest plugin mut_ignore_scaled_sigma, no repository source edits
measurements.result: before 2 passed; after 2 failed in 0.07s, both small suites
